tweetMedia.transcription: This guy has no idea he's licked a chemical used to deliver chemotherapy. Dairy Queen is fake! That's according to the FDA, whose own regulations say this cream is held together by pharmaceutical emulsifiers. Dairy Queen is barely held together with six binders. It starts as artificial dairy, sweetened with liquid sugar and pumped with polysorbate 80, used in chemo wards. That base is dipped in counterfeit chocolate, just hydrogenated oil and stripped cocoa, topped with petroleum-based vanilla. Halo Top, Oreo, and Breyers, all scanned as non-legal ice cream in the expo.
